pm_exper_user_4828_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could host a small picnic in a scenic park, encouraging guests to bring blankets and favorite snacks so you can all enjoy the surroundings together. Bringing along some games or music would make the most of the pleasant atmosphere.
(b) You could host a small picnic under the stars, encouraging guests to bring blankets and warm drinks so you can all lie back and stargaze together. Bringing along a telescope or binoculars would make the most of a perfectly clear night sky.
(c) Plan an evening 'star walk' in a dark-sky park where you guide friends through constellations and planets that are visible in the clear conditions. You might even time it with a specific astronomical event, like a meteor shower, for extra wonder.
(d) Organize an outdoor dinner lit only by lanterns and candles, letting the clear night sky serve as the backdrop. After the meal, everyone could spend some quiet time spotting constellations and satellites as they pass overhead.
